title: Sonic.EXE Laugh
blurb: The Sonic.EXE laugh — the distorted cackle from gaming's most famous creepypasta. It's the sound of a childhood mascot gone deeply wrong, and it still carries that early-YouTube horror charge. Use it for corrupted-character bits, fake-out scares, and edits where something wholesome turns sinister. Kept alive by every FNF mod and horror retrospective since.
origin: From the Sonic.EXE creepypasta and its game adaptations.
